task.title: Receipt OCR to structured JSON
task.business_story: Expense-management and bookkeeping tools turn photographed receipts into ledger entries; after OCR the text is jumbled, and a model has to pull out the line items and totals for every receipt a customer uploads. It runs once per document at high volume, so the per-call price decides the margin.

verdict.system_prompt:
Parse Indonesian receipt OCR to JSON. Output ONLY: {"items":[],"subtotal":int|null,"discount":int|null,"service_charge":int|null,"tax":int|null,"total":int|null,"cash_paid":int|null,"change":int|null}.

CRITICAL RULES:
- ITEMS: Each line with a right-aligned price = one item. Name = text before price (strip leading "1 " or "2 "). Qty = that leading integer else null. SKIP lines where: price is 0/missing, name ends with " DEL", line starts with space/indent, or contains "x1" "x2" pattern (sub-items).
- TAX vs DISCOUNT: "PB1", "PPN", "Pajak", "Tax" -> tax (positive). "Disc", "Promo", "Less" -> discount. NEVER map PB1 to discount.
- SUBTOTAL: Use "Subtotal", "NET1 AMT", "NET Sales".
- SERVICE CHARGE: "Svc Chg", "Service", "P.Rest".
- TOTAL: "Total", "Grand Total".
- CASH/CHANGE: "Cash", "Bayar" / "Change", "Kembali", "Changed". Change=null if line absent (not 0).
- NUMBERS: Strip all non-digits. "25,000"->25000.
- MISSING FIELDS = null. No calculations.

EXAMPLES:
Input: "1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636\nSubTotal: 13,636\nPB1: 1,364\nTotal: 15,000\ncash: 20,000\nChange: 5,000"
Output: {"items":[{"name":"Peanut & Cheese","quantity":1,"price":13636}],"subtotal":13636,"discount":null,"service_charge":null,"tax":1364,"total":15000,"cash_paid":20000,"change":5000}

Input: "1 20,000\nTT 20,000\nTOTAL 20,000\nCASH 100,000\nCHANGE 80,000"
Output: {"items":[{"name":"TT","quantity":1,"price":20000}],"subtotal":null,"discount":null,"service_charge":null,"tax":null,"total":20000,"cash_paid":100000,"change":80000}

Input: "LE MINERAL 8,000\n1.00\nNET1 AMT 7,273\nTAX AMT 727\nTOTAL 8,000\nCASH 8,000"
Output: {"items":[{"name":"LE MINERAL","quantity":1,"price":8000}],"subtotal":7273,"discount":null,"service_charge":null,"tax":727,"total":8000,"cash_paid":8000,"change":null}

verdict.snippet:
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NEBIUS_API_KEY"])

MODEL = 'nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B'
THINKING = False  # Nemotron reasoning; off is faster and cheaper
SYSTEM = 'Parse Indonesian receipt OCR to JSON. Output ONLY: {"items":[],"subtotal":int|null,"discount":int|null,"service_charge":int|null,"tax":int|null,"total":int|null,"cash_paid":int|null,"change":int|null}.\n\nCRITICAL RULES:\n- ITEMS: Each line with a right-aligned price = one item. Name = text before price (strip leading "1 " or "2 "). Qty = that leading integer else null. SKIP lines where: price is 0/missing, name ends with " DEL", line starts with space/indent, or contains "x1" "x2" pattern (sub-items).\n- TAX vs DISCOUNT: "PB1", "PPN", "Pajak", "Tax" -> tax (positive). "Disc", "Promo", "Less" -> discount. NEVER map PB1 to discount.\n- SUBTOTAL: Use "Subtotal", "NET1 AMT", "NET Sales".\n- SERVICE CHARGE: "Svc Chg", "Service", "P.Rest".\n- TOTAL: "Total", "Grand Total".\n- CASH/CHANGE: "Cash", "Bayar" / "Change", "Kembali", "Changed". Change=null if line absent (not 0).\n- NUMBERS: Strip all non-digits. "25,000"->25000.\n- MISSING FIELDS = null. No calculations.\n\nEXAMPLES:\nInput: "1 Peanut & Cheese 13,636\\nSubTotal: 13,636\\nPB1: 1,364\\nTotal: 15,000\\ncash: 20,000\\nChange: 5,000"\nOutput: {"items":[{"name":"Peanut & Cheese","quantity":1,"price":13636}],"subtotal":13636,"discount":null,"service_charge":null,"tax":1364,"total":15000,"cash_paid":20000,"change":5000}\n\nInput: "1 20,000\\nTT 20,000\\nTOTAL 20,000\\nCASH 100,000\\nCHANGE 80,000"\nOutput: {"items":[{"name":"TT","quantity":1,"price":20000}],"subtotal":null,"discount":null,"service_charge":null,"tax":null,"total":20000,"cash_paid":100000,"change":80000}\n\nInput: "LE MINERAL 8,000\\n1.00\\nNET1 AMT 7,273\\nTAX AMT 727\\nTOTAL 8,000\\nCASH 8,000"\nOutput: {"items":[{"name":"LE MINERAL","quantity":1,"price":8000}],"subtotal":7273,"discount":null,"service_charge":null,"tax":727,"total":8000,"cash_paid":8000,"change":null}'
FEW_SHOT = []


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=445,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
